offers_products.reason: Processes and sells canned and frozen fruits and vegetables under brands like Libby's, Green Giant (licensed), and private label.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from packaged food products; no main service offering.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Branded canned vegetables and fruits sold through retail stores; shoppers choose the brand.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to retailers (including private label), foodservice, industrial and international customers, plus government programs.

recurring_revenue.reason: Staple canned and frozen foods are reordered repeatedly by grocery retailers and foodservice customers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Canned vegetables and fruits are grocery staples; demand holds up or rises in recessions.

big_ticket.reason: Low-priced, frequently purchased canned food items.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured food products, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are large grocery retailers, private-label customers, foodservice distributors and government programs, though consumers also buy.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates many processing plants, can-making facilities, farmland and warehouses requiring ongoing capital investment.

notes: Large_customers is a judgment call given retail, private label and consumer brand mix.
